items.title: How much does a deliberately targeted opportunity move the needle?
items.description: Using an illustrative point system (each opportunity deliberately targeted at a named gap is worth 70 points of evidence strength, capped at 100), drag the number of targeted opportunities Alex takes on to see how convincing the resulting evidence becomes. At 1 opportunity — the migration RFC from L3 — this reproduces a strong but not maxed-out case; at 0, there's nothing to bring to the next calibration conversation at all.
